resources.string: Understand how your brain experiences time
Analyze focus, stress and emotions to predict perceived time duration.

• Stress can make time feel slower
• Deep focus often makes time feel faster
• Calm emotional states improve time awareness
• Productivity levels influence perceived duration
• Emotional balance affects cognitive processing speed
Move the slider to represent your current concentration level.

Chrono Sense combines task complexity, focus intensity and emotional state to estimate perceived time duration. The app demonstrates how psychological conditions can distort time awareness during daily activities.
